descriptions.Termidor HE Termite Treatment: Trench and treat the soil around the full foundation perimeter with Termidor HE, creating a continuous treated zone that eliminates termites that pass through it.
descriptions.Soil Pre-Treatment: Treat the soil under the planned addition or slab before it is poured, so new construction starts out protected against termites.
descriptions.Fungus/Beetle Treatment: Treat exposed framing in the crawl space with a borate wood treatment to kill and prevent wood-decay fungus and wood-boring beetles.
descriptions.DSV Fog (under 1,500 sq ft): Fog the crawl space with a disinfectant to kill mold, mildew, and odor-causing bacteria (crawl spaces under 1,500 sq ft).
descriptions.DSV Fog (over 1,500 sq ft): Fog the crawl space with a disinfectant to kill mold, mildew, and odor-causing bacteria (crawl spaces over 1,500 sq ft).
descriptions.Rubber Mulch (termite resistant): Remove existing wood mulch from around the foundation, install weed barrier with a granular treatment, and replace with rubber mulch that will not feed termites.
descriptions.One-Time Pest Service (not advertised): One-time interior and exterior pest treatment. No guarantee.
descriptions.Talent Basic (not advertised): General pest control: quarterly service with unlimited call-backs and re-treatments between visits.
descriptions.Talent Plus: General pest and rodent control: quarterly service with unlimited call-backs and re-treatments between visits.
descriptions.Talent Premium: General pest, rodent, and mosquito control: quarterly service with unlimited call-backs and re-treatments between visits.
descriptions.Sentricon (no active termites): Install Sentricon termite bait stations around the home, with ongoing monitoring and protection.
descriptions.Sentricon (no active termites, over 400: Install Sentricon termite bait stations around the home (over 400 linear ft of foundation), with ongoing monitoring and protection.
descriptions.Termite Warranty: Annual termite warranty: yearly inspection, with re-treatment if termites return.
descriptions.Dehumidifier Maintenance: Service visit every 6 months: clean the dehumidifier, change the filter, and change tubing if needed. Talent-installed units only.
descriptions.Encapsulation Warranty: Annual encapsulation warranty covering the dehumidifier and vapor barrier, with repairs to the barrier as needed.
descriptions.Mosquito (stand-alone): Mosquito treatment around the yard during mosquito season.
descriptions.Attic Insulation R-49 (13 in), removal 1: Remove existing attic insulation (10 in or less), then install Pro-Shield pest-control insulation to R-49 (about 13 in), the Department of Energy recommended level. Pro-Shield is treated with boric acid for lasting pest control and added fire resistance.
descriptions.Attic Insulation R-49 (13 in), removal o: Remove existing attic insulation (over 10 in), then install Pro-Shield pest-control insulation to R-49 (about 13 in), the Department of Energy recommended level. Pro-Shield is treated with boric acid for lasting pest control and added fire resistance.
descriptions.Attic Insulation Cap (6 in), install onl: Add a 6 in layer of Pro-Shield pest-control insulation over the existing insulation to improve comfort and energy efficiency.
descriptions.Floor Joist: Sister or replace damaged floor joists with new treated lumber to restore strength to the floor.
descriptions.Sill Plate (under 8 ft): Replace damaged sill plate (under 8 ft per section) with new treated lumber where the house framing sits on the foundation.
descriptions.Band Board (first 3 sections): Replace damaged band board (rim joist) with new treated lumber, first 3 sections.
descriptions.Band Board (each section after 3): Replace additional sections of damaged band board (rim joist) with new treated lumber.
descriptions.Girder: Replace or reinforce the damaged girder (main support beam) to restore support to the floor system.
descriptions.Subfloor Section: Replace a damaged section of subfloor from below with new material.
descriptions.Subfloor Remove & Replace (top down): Remove damaged subfloor from above and install new subfloor, including demo and new board.
descriptions.Dumpster Fee (large demo): Dumpster and disposal of debris from the demolition work.
descriptions.New Crawl Vent: Install a new crawl space foundation vent.
descriptions.New Crawl Door: Install a new, tight-fitting crawl space access door.
descriptions.New Crawl Door with Frame / Custom: Build and install a custom crawl space access door with a new frame.
descriptions.Misc Hourly Work: Additional labor as described, billed per person, per hour.
descriptions.Vapor Barrier (10 mil): Install a 10 mil vapor barrier over the crawl space floor to block ground moisture.
descriptions.Vapor Barrier (10 mil), taped seams: Install a 10 mil vapor barrier over the crawl space floor with all seams taped, to block ground moisture.
descriptions.Vapor Barrier (12 mil woven): Install a heavy-duty 12 mil reinforced woven vapor barrier over the crawl space floor to block ground moisture.
descriptions.Vapor Barrier (12 mil woven), taped seam: Install a heavy-duty 12 mil reinforced woven vapor barrier over the crawl space floor with all seams taped.
descriptions.Vapor Barrier (20 mil): Install a premium 20 mil reinforced vapor barrier over the crawl space floor, tough enough for crawl space foot traffic.
descriptions.Vapor Barrier (20 mil), taped seams: Install a premium 20 mil reinforced vapor barrier over the crawl space floor with all seams taped.
descriptions.Vapor Barrier Install Only: Install customer-supplied vapor barrier over the crawl space floor.
descriptions.Vapor Barrier Removal Only: Remove and dispose of the old vapor barrier.
descriptions.Dehumidifier (with electrician): Install an Aprilaire crawl space dehumidifier, including a dedicated outlet installed by a licensed electrician, to keep humidity at safe levels year round.
descriptions.Dehumidifier (no outlet needed): Install an Aprilaire crawl space dehumidifier using the existing outlet, to keep humidity at safe levels year round.
descriptions.Dehumidifier Swap (no electrician): Replace the existing dehumidifier with a new Aprilaire unit.
descriptions.Vent Covers: Seal foundation vents with insulated covers to keep humid outside air out of the crawl space.
descriptions.Sump Pump (with electrician): Install a sump pump with a dedicated outlet installed by a licensed electrician, discharging water away from the home.
descriptions.Sump Pump (no electrician): Install a sump pump using the existing outlet, discharging water away from the home.
descriptions.Additional Sump Pump: Install an additional sump pump to handle the length of the drain system.
descriptions.French Drain (outside): Install an exterior French drain along the foundation to collect water and carry it away from the home.
descriptions.French Drain (inside): Install an interior French drain around the crawl space perimeter to collect water and direct it to the sump pump.
descriptions.Screen Crawl Vents: Screen foundation vents to keep rodents and wildlife out of the crawl space.
descriptions.Drip Edge (one story): Install drip edge flashing along the roofline to direct rainwater away from the foundation and seal gaps where pests enter.
descriptions.Custom Drip Edge (one story): Install custom bent metal drip edge flashing to seal builder gaps along the roofline and direct water away from the home.
descriptions.Siding Shield: Install siding shield flashing along the bottom of the siding to keep water and pests out.
descriptions.Full Encapsulation (with foam): Complete crawl space encapsulation: 20 mil vapor barrier sealed to the walls with taped seams, foam board on the walls, vent covers, an Aprilaire dehumidifier with electrician, and a fungus treatment.
descriptions.Full Encapsulation (no foam): Complete crawl space encapsulation: 20 mil vapor barrier sealed to the walls with taped seams, vent covers, an Aprilaire dehumidifier with electrician, and a fungus treatment.
descriptions.Crawl Space Insulation Install (R19): Install R-19 insulation between the floor joists to keep floors warmer and lower energy costs.
descriptions.Crawl Space Insulation Removal: Remove and dispose of old, damaged, or fallen crawl space insulation.
descriptions.Crawl Space Insulation Removal + Install: Remove old crawl space insulation and install new R-19 insulation between the floor joists.
